technique_name: Describe how you solved a complex problem.
description: When I encountered a complex problem, I started by breaking down the problem into smaller, more manageable pieces. I then analyzed each piece and identified patterns or commonalities between the different pieces. With this knowledge, I created a structured plan with specific objectives for each step in resolving the complex problem.
